archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / TACTICAL MINIMALISM (Scientific Engineering & Precision Instrumentation)
rationale: The IMS Platform is a serious numerical-analysis and control-theory research platform. The visual tone must evoke high-precision laboratory instruments (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, control-system workbenches) while remaining welcoming and exploratory for academic researchers and students. High-contrast dark theme with sharp borders, dense structured layout, ISO/standard scientific metric notations, interactive formula tooltips, and crystal-clear semantic color coding for mathematical claim levels ensures readability and zero ambiguity between mathematical identities and empirical simulations.

entry_surfaces./: Instrument workspace layout with top telemetry/action bar, 3-column analysis grid (Config Left, Analytical Stability Middle, Time-series Charts Right), and bottom claim-verification audit trail.

layouts.container: w-full max-w-[1720px] mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 space-y-6

header_bar.description: Top telemetry bar showing model name 'Ideal 4-State Stabilizing-MRC [x = (i_L, v_b, sigma, v_o)]', educational tooltips explaining state variables, model validation status badge, active preset selector (e.g. 'Nominal CPL 200W', 'Near-Bifurcation', 'Deep Disturbance', 'Academic Benchmark'), and action buttons: Compute Equilibrium, Run Transient ODE, CSV Export, PDF Report Generator.

parameter_entry_form.description: Precision 2-column tabular input form with inline validation, physical units (H, F, Ohm, V, W), mathematical explanations, and bounds checking. Groups: 1) Circuit Plant (L, C, R, v_in), 2) CPL & Load (P_cpl, R_load), 3) Controller (k_m, k_p, k_i, v_ref), 4) Disturbance & Solver (t_dist_start, t_dist_end, P_cpl_dist, t_final, dt_max, rtol, atol).

equilibrium_panel.description: Displays analytical closed-form equilibrium vector x* = [i_L*, v_b*, sigma*, v_o*], duty cycle d*, and the numerical closed-loop vector field residual ||f_cl(x*)||_inf with high-precision scientific formatting. Highlights near-zero convergence with explanatory tooltips for students.

stability_analysis_panel.description: Full local stability analysis breakdown: 1) 4x4 Closed-Loop Jacobian Matrix A_cl, 2) Eigenvalues lambda_1..4, 3) Transverse eigenvalue vs -k_m (showing exact manifold contraction rate), 4) Reduced 3x3 system eigenvalues, 5) Characteristic polynomial coefficients (a3, a2, a1, a0), 6) Routh-Hurwitz 4 conditions table with explicit positive numeric margins.

claim_level_legend.description: Crucial distinction component that visually categorizes claims into 4 strict epistemological tiers with distinct badges, borders, and definitions to prevent conflating mathematical proofs with empirical simulations.

tiers.title: Exact Contraction Identity
tiers.definition: e_Sigma_dot = -k_m * e_Sigma holds algebraically across the entire state space (transverse exponential contraction rate -k_m).

tiers.title: Local Asymptotic Stability
tiers.definition: Verified analytically via Jacobian eigenvalues in Re(lambda) < 0 and strictly positive Routh-Hurwitz margins around x*.

tiers.title: Observed Numerical Recovery
tiers.definition: Trajectory computed via adaptive RK45 / Radau solver under finite-time CPL pulse disturbance returning to epsilon-ball of x*.

tiers.title: Certified Regional IMS
tiers.definition: Lyapunov or invariant set boundary certification (requires certified region estimation).

synchronized_charts_panel.description: Five stacked synchronized time-series charts using Recharts with shared crosshair cursor and brush zoom: 1) Bus Voltage v_b(t), 2) Inductor Current i_L(t), 3) Internal State sigma(t), 4) Output Voltage v_o(t), 5) Manifold Residual |e_Sigma(t)| with logarithmic/symlog toggle. Includes disturbance entry/exit vertical reference spans, equilibrium dashed lines, and tooltip matrix readout.

simulation_status_and_export.description: Summary status cards displaying Solver Status (e.g. 'Converged (RK45, 1420 steps)'), Recovery Outcome ('Recovered to < 0.01% of x* in 14.2ms'), Peak Residual, and direct export actions for CSV time-series and printable LaTeX/PDF verification report.

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (APCA high-contrast for numbers and charts)
accessibility.colorblind_safety: All claim levels and pass/fail statuses pair color with explicit icon glyphs (CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, ShieldCheck, Sigma, Compass) and clear text badges so state is never conveyed by color alone.
accessibility.numeric_readability: Tabular numerals with monospace styling prevents layout shift during live simulation runs.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Preserve the existing platform structure: Integrate this page into the existing router (e.g. `/mrc-stabilization` or `/ims/four-state-mrc`) with navigation link in the top/sidebar nav.

2. Mathematical correctness: Ensure all formulas (closed-form equilibrium x*, Jacobian linearization matrix, Routh-Hurwitz conditions, manifold residual calculation e_Sigma = v_b - v_b_target, ODE simulation) are numerically exact with explicit precision.

3. Claim Level demarcation: Rigorously apply the 4 distinct claim-level colors (#10B981 Emerald for Exact Identity, #0284C7 Sky for Local Stability, #F59E0B Amber for Observed Recovery, #A855F7 Purple for Certified Regional) to badges, section headers, and tooltips so the user never conflates analytical proof with simulation observation.
4. Chart synchronization: Use Recharts with `syncId='ims-mrc-sim'` so hovering any chart syncs the vertical cursor across all 5 state plots (v_b, i_L, sigma, v_o, e_Sigma).
5. Export features: Provide working client/server CSV download with all trajectory columns (t, i_l, v_b, sigma, v_o, e_sigma, p_cpl) and a clean structured PDF/Print report layout.
6. Include all specified data-testids on buttons, inputs, metrics, badges, and chart containers for automated test verification.
7. Set dark mode theme tokens in `/app/frontend/src/index.css` using the palette provided in surfaces and signals.
